Interface SecurityFundamentalJpaRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<SecurityFundamental>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>
public interface SecurityFundamentalJpaRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<SecurityFundamental, SecurityFundamental.SecurityFundamentalKey>
Fundamental base values per security, metric and source. The weekly load task writes them; the watchlist indicator report reads only the selected ones.

    • findSelectedByIds

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<SecurityFundamentalJpaRepository.SelectedFundamental> findSelectedByIds(List<Integer> idsSecuritycurrency, LocalDate asOfDate)
      Loads the rows that bind an expression variable for several securities in one round trip. The freshness and the split rule of the selection are applied again with the date of the request, so that values expire on schedule even when the load task is disabled or keeps failing. Named query: SecurityFundamental.findSelectedByIds
      • Only rows in state CONFIRMED, CHECKED or SINGLE (1, 2, 3) of the seven bound metrics (1–7).
      • A dated row counts while its period ended at most 18 months before asOfDate, an undated row while it was fetched at most 21 days before.
      • Every row of a security is skipped that was fetched on or before the day of a split of that security: the new price would otherwise be combined with per-share values of the old share count.
      • exchangeRate turns the value into the currency of the security: 1 for the share count and for a value in that currency, otherwise the newest close of the currency pair up to asOfDate, inverted when only the reverse pair exists, and null when no pair or no currency is known.
      Parameters:
      idsSecuritycurrency - the securities (?1)
      asOfDate - the day of the request (?2)
      Returns:
      the selected rows with the rate into the currency of their security

    • findScopeIds

      @Query(nativeQuery=true) List<Integer> findScopeIds(byte categoryType, byte specInvestInstrument, LocalDate activeOnDate)
      Ids of the securities the weekly load covers: active direct equities in a watchlist of any tenant or in a transaction, the universe of the fundamental source probe. Named query: SecurityFundamental.findScopeIds
      Parameters:
      categoryType - byte value of AssetclassType.EQUITIES (?1)
      specInvestInstrument - byte value of SpecialInvestmentInstruments.DIRECT_INVESTMENT (?2)
      activeOnDate - the security must be active on this day (?3)
      Returns:
      the ids in ascending order
